## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **BoneChilling-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe** | Windows installer (recommended). Double-click, then Next. No admin rights needed. |
| BoneChilling-{{VERSION}}-portable-win64.zip | Portable version: unzip anywhere and run `BoneChilling.exe`. |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums to verify the downloads. |

**Windows SmartScreen:** the installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may show *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

**Requirements:** Windows 10/11 (64-bit) with Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11 and most Windows 10 PCs).

**AI engine:** install [Ollama](https://ollama.com/download) to run everything privately on the PC (the app guides you through downloading a model), or paste your own cloud API key in Settings. Patient data and keys stay on the PC.

> Assistive tool. It reports objective facts only; every finding must be verified by a qualified physician.
